text: Ilias Thorne tied the game for Ironvale Athletic with a clever finish from close range after a quick counter-attack sparked by Jonah Lindqvist's short pass. This goal came at 86 minutes and evened the score at 3-3, showing Ironvale’s strength in hitting back fast despite sitting deep and defending heavily. Over the last 10 minutes, Ironvale held onto the ball more, with 61.5% possession, and threw three shots at the goal, backing up their comeback fight [#1537] [#1534].
